+"""LLM labels for HDBSCAN clusters (checked by hand afterwards)."""
+import csv, json
+import numpy as np
+from openai import OpenAI
+from dynamite.cluster import embed, cluster
+
+PROMPT = """Below are forum posts from one cluster of a class discussion board.
+Give a literal label of 2-5 words for what they have in common, one plain sentence describing it,
+and your confidence (low, medium, high). Reply as JSON: {{"label": ..., "description": ..., "confidence": ...}}
+
+Posts:
+{posts}"""
+
+
+def central(X, lab, k, n=12):
+    idx = np.where(lab == k)[0]
+    c = X[idx].mean(axis=0)
+    return idx[np.argsort(np.linalg.norm(X[idx] - c, axis=1))[:n]]
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    posts = [json.loads(l) for l in open("data/posts.jsonl")]
+    X = embed(posts); lab = cluster(X, 15)
+    client = OpenAI()
+    with open("data/cluster_labels.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
+        w = csv.writer(f); w.writerow(["cluster", "size", "label", "description", "confidence"])
+        for k in range(lab.max() + 1):
+            sample = "\n---\n".join(posts[i]["text"][:600] for i in central(X, lab, k))
+            r = client.chat.completions.create(model="gpt-5-mini", response_format={"type": "json_object"},
+                                               messages=[{"role": "user", "content": PROMPT.format(posts=sample)}])
+            j = json.loads(r.choices[0].message.content)
+            w.writerow([k, int((lab == k).sum()), j["label"], j["description"], j["confidence"]])
*** End Patch
